relationships.subject: Rho GTPase
relationships.evidence_quote: Inhibition of Rho GTPase was found to reduce the severity of withdrawal syndrome

key_findings: Rho GTPase inhibitor ML141 dose-dependently reduced mecamylamine-precipitated nicotine withdrawal signs (hyperalgesia, piloerection, jumping, tremors, WSS) in mice.
